item.title: Rallying Cry – November 21, 2026
item.description: Scientists saved a rare dinosaur fossil from auction, Tamil Nadu is creating a lifesaving registry for rare blood donors, and a British swimmer took on the Strait of Hormuz to raise awareness about war's environmental toll.
